svg.title: Selector lifecycle
svg.desc: A selector is bound and picks its option (selector.viewed, once): ?forceBundleId, the one in the cart, data-next-selected, else the first. Options with no price from the last 10 minutes are calculated (selector.calculating), then priced (selector.calculated); when every price is from the last 10 minutes it is priced at once, and those prices are checked again once a page (selector.calculated again). Picking another option sends selector.selected. Changing the picked option’s quantity or a slot sends selector.updated and prices again; a coupon change prices again without selector.updated. Pricing that fails sends sdk.error and moves to unpriced: each option keeps its last price, else the package price; the next change prices again.

text.tspan: Prices from the last 10 minutes are checked again once a page: selector.calculated again
A coupon change prices the options again, without selector.updated
Swap mode (the default) also puts the pick in the cart: cart.updated follows
A toggle: selector.selected when switched on, selector.deselected when its line leaves the cart
